markdown_content: ## Overview: Reverse-Engineering a Real Jacket in CLO with Pattern Drafter This walkthrough shows how to recreate a measured women’s jacket in **CLO** using **Pattern Drafter**, then add sleeves, cuffs, collar, hem band, fabric, a center-front zipper, and custom rendering. The process is driven by entering real measurements into Pattern Drafter, generating base pattern pieces, and using CLO tools (simulation, sewing, unfolding/unfold symmetric editing, superimpose, folding) to build the garment. --- ## CLO Setup: Version, Units, and Input/Navigation Settings This section covers the key UI settings needed to follow along correctly: **CLO version**, **measurement system (Inches vs Metric)**, and **mouse/controls** differences. - The presenter is using **CLO 2025.2**. - The **CLO library** button has moved to the **upper-right corner** (shortcut icon). - Shortcut: press **Y** to open the library (may open on another monitor). - Units: - Open **Settings → User Settings → User Interface**. - Set **measurement system to Inches** for this tutorial (Imperial). Users elsewhere should switch to **metric** as needed. - Mouse/controls: - View controls differ depending on device (PC mouse vs touchpad vs Apple Magic Mouse). - Example setup: “regular mouse” with right-click, left-click, and middle scroll. --- ## Import and Position the Avatar (Mannequin) This section explains how to load a CLO mannequin avatar from the library and ensure it sits properly on the floor. 1. Open **CLO Library** (upper-right icon or press **Y**). 2. Go to **Main CLO library → Avatar folder → Mannequin**. 3. Open **female V2.1 mannequin** (double-click). 4.
